title: Network Administrator
description:
Job Description Network Administrator Role: Network Administrator
 Department: IT / Infrastructure
 Location: Campus
 Job Summary We are looking for a Network Administrator who will be responsible for maintaining, monitoring, and troubleshooting the campus network and ICT infrastructure. The role requires hands-on technical expertise to quickly identify and resolve issues related to Wi-Fi, LAN, CCTV, networking equipment, and other ICT devices , ensuring uninterrupted operations across the campus. Key Responsibilities 1. Network & Wi-Fi Management Monitor the campus Wi-Fi and LAN network to ensure stable and reliable connectivity. Identify and troubleshoot issues related to slow internet, connectivity drops, dead zones, access points, switches, routers, and network configuration . Diagnose network issues independently and implement appropriate solutions. Coordinate with the ISP/service providers for issues related to internet connectivity and bandwidth. Ensure all network equipment is properly configured and functioning. Conduct regular checks of network infrastructure and identify potential issues proactively. 2. CCTV & Surveillance Systems Monitor and troubleshoot CCTV-related issues across the campus. Resolve issues related to camera connectivity, recording, display, NVR/DVR, storage, cabling, and network connectivity . Ensure CCTV systems are operational and recordings are available when required. Coordinate with external CCTV vendors for hardware-level issues or replacements where necessary. 3. ICT Device Troubleshooting Provide first-level troubleshooting and technical support for campus ICT equipment. Troubleshoot issues related to projectors, TVs/displays, audio systems, microphones, speakers, video conferencing equipment, printers, and other ICT devices . Identify whether an issue is related to hardware, software, configuration, connectivity, or power supply and take appropriate corrective action. Ensure classroom and meeting-room ICT equipment is operational and ready for use. 4. Preventive Maintenance Conduct regular preventive checks of network and ICT infrastructure. Maintain an inventory of network equipment and ICT devices. Identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions. Maintain proper documentation of network configurations, equipment, repairs, and replacements. 5. Vendor & Service Coordination Coordinate with network, CCTV, ISP, and ICT equipment vendors whenever external support is required. Follow up with vendors to ensure issues are resolved within agreed timelines. Verify the resolution of issues before closing service requests. Required Skills & Qualifications Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking, Electronics, or a related field . 2–5 years of relevant experience in network administration or IT infrastructure support. Strong troubleshooting skills across Wi-Fi, LAN, routers, switches, access points, and basic network infrastructure . Hands-on knowledge of CCTV/NVR/DVR systems . Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, and network troubleshooting. Ability to troubleshoot ICT equipment such as displays, projectors, audio systems, and conference-room equipment. Good vendor coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently and respond quickly to on-ground technical issues. Key Competencies Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability Hands-on technical approach Ability to diagnose issues independently Quick response to critical network/ICT issues Preventive maintenance mindset Good communication and vendor-management skills Ability to manage multiple issues and prioritize based on operational impact Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Network/Wi-Fi uptime and stability Response and resolution time for network and ICT issues Timely resolution of CCTV and classroom ICT issues Reduction in recurring technical issues Preventive maintenance completion Vendor issues closed within agreed timelines Overall availability and readiness of campus ICT infrastructure

Key Skills: Network troubleshooting,Troubleshooting,CCTV,Administration,Load,Networking,LAN troubleshooting,CCNA

title: Civil Structural Engineer onshore
description:
Job Summary**

We are seeking a talented and experienced Civil Structural Engineer to join our onshore team at Cyient, Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, analysis, and evaluation of civil and structural components for various onshore projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and client specifications.

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform structural analysis and design of foundations, steel structures, concrete elements, and other civil components for onshore facilities, including industrial plants, power generation facilities, and infrastructure projects.
* Develop engineering drawings, specifications, and reports using relevant software and tools (e.g., AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS).
* Conduct site visits and inspections to assess existing conditions, gather data, and monitor construction progress.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including architects, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, and project managers, to ensure integrated and efficient project execution.
* Review and interpret technical documents, codes, and standards (e.g., AISC, ACI, ASCE, IBC) to ensure design integrity and compliance.
* Prepare technical proposals, cost estimates, and project schedules.
* Identify and resolve engineering challenges, providing innovative and cost-effective solutions.
* Participate in client meetings and presentations, effectively communicating technical information.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the professional development of the team.
* Adhere to company safety policies and procedures at all times.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution. Master's degree preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license is highly preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in civil and structural design for onshore projects.
* Proficiency in structural analysis and design software such as STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, or similar.
* Strong understanding of relevant building codes and industry standards (AISC, ACI, ASCE, IBC).
* Experience with AutoCAD and/or other drafting software.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as required.

title: Customer Emissions Reporting  EGS
description:
Role Purpose: Mid-level sustainability professional to support Group Sustainability, with a primary focus on customer emissions reporting and sustainability data management. Should have prior experience in Sustainability emission reporting and ESG reporting standards. The Sustainability Emission Reporting Specialist shall be responsible for managing and reporting the organizations greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and other environmental metrics. The data source will be our own Data lake which will allow Power BI to generate reports and or templates shared by the emission tool provider EcoTransIT. We will capture the lane info. in a given template and use the online calculator to prepare the final reports. Should also have good communication skills so that they are able to do knowledge sharing or training as needed. This role shall ensure accurate data collection, analysis on demand basis, answering queries received on the data shared. Key Responsibilities Implement & manage end-to-end customer emissions reporting processes, including data collection, validation, governance, and reporting. Act as the central support resource for global customer emissions reporting requests, managing quarterly, semi-annual, and annual reporting requirements based on customer and commercial team needs. Deliver customer-facing emissions reports while driving continuous improvements in reporting processes, data quality, and automation. Develop and maintain a centralized database of DP World's sustainability capabilities, solutions, case studies, credentials, and customer references across regions and business units. Coordinate closely with regional teams, GHSE, and Group Sustainability to ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness of emissions and sustainability data. Key Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in environmental science, Sustainability, Engineering, or related field. 6 to 8 years of experience in sustainability reporting or environmental data management. Strong understanding of GHG accounting standards (e.g., GHG Protocol). Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI, or ESG software platforms). Excellent communication We are looking into various reporting categories. Power BI will be used for regular or on -demand reports (that DPW will share with customers) ; here with API integration, data will be exchanged between TiaB and ETW, and user would just need to use the right template in Power BI to download the customer report, do sanity checks and share it with the customer or internal stakeholder Use Mass calculation tool : a pre-defined template will be used, data will be keyed in by the sender, the GSC will coordinate the data completion, quality checks and make use of the solution to calculate the emissions and share the final reports with the needed stakeholders. Multiple lane emission calculations for tenders (pre shipment) Multiple lane simulations for the various end customers shipments handled not in TiaB (post shipment) Multiple lane simulation to build case study for the customers pre shipment (pre shipment)

title: Sr. Salesforce Administrator
description:
About the Role: Revenue Operations plays a critical role in ensuring financial success by improving the platforms, operations, and systems supporting our go-to-market teams. This team partners with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to deliver scalable and efficient processes across the customer lifecycle, from lead generation to revenue recognition. Revenue Operations is essential to achieving our company’s revenue and operational goals. As a Senior Salesforce Administrator at PitchBook, you will play a crucial role in optimizing and maintaining our Salesforce ecosystem to drive efficiency and productivity across Sales & Customer Success business functions. You will be responsible for overseeing the configuration, customization, and integration of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Experience Cloud, and Salesforce Service Cloud to meet the evolving needs of our organization. This role requires a deep understanding of Salesforce best practices, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions that enhance user experience and support our business objectives. 

 Primary Job Responsibilities: Administer and configure Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Salesforce Experience Cloud to support the needs of different departments such as sales, finance, and customer service. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement changes within Salesforce.  Develop and maintain custom objects, fields, formulas, workflows, validation rules, and process builder flows to automate business processes and improve data integrity.  Manage user access, profiles, roles, permission sets, and security settings to ensure data privacy and compliance with company policies.  Lead efforts to integrate Salesforce with other systems and third-party applications using APIs, middleware, and other integration tools.  Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide technical support to end-users.  Stay updated on new Salesforce features and releases, assess their impact on existing configurations, and recommend enhancements.  Create and maintain documentation, including user guides, process diagrams, and training materials.  Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested.  Be a resource for other admins on the Team    Skills and Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) required; additional certifications such as Advanced Administrator (ADM 211) and Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce CPQ preferred.  5+ years of experience working as a Salesforce Administrator, with a focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Salesforce Experience Cloud.  Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, customization, automation and administration, including but not limited to custom objects, workflows, validation rules, and security settings.  Experience with Salesforce Lightning Experience and Lightning App Builder.  Strong understanding of relational databases and SOQL queries.  Excellent problem-solving & Root cause analysis skills and ability to analyze complex business requirements.  Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.  Experience working in an Agile environment and familiarity with Agile methodologies is a plus.  Nice to have: Experience with Gearset, Gitlab, Gong, LeanData, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.    Working Conditions        The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events. 
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

Key Skills: Root Cause Analysis,Salesforce Sales Cloud,Administration,Automation,Customization,Salesforce Lightning,Salesforce Integration,Soql
